elements.name: left wall with row of large side windows
worn seat backs receding toward far end
young passenger in nearest seat by window
seen from behind, head/shoulders/arm above seat back
backpack on empty seat beside him
steep forested mountain slopes through windows

wrong_setting: The dense conifer forest reads as alpine or North American, not Ethiopian highlands.
anatomy: He sits sideways on the seat cushion with his legs out in the aisle, which makes the seat geometry confusing. The backpack appears twice: one on a separate lower-left seat and an olive bag in his lap.
notes: Reframe from behind so only his head, shoulders and arm show above the seat back, put a single backpack on the empty seat beside him, give the sandals closed toes, and swap the pines for Ethiopian highland vegetation.
